title: Mana Engine
text: Place a crystal casing in the assembly bench's center. Clockwise from the upper right, place: spiritual crystal, iron block, spiritual crystal, redstone block, spiritual crystal, low-tier spell crystal. This fixed arrangement forges a mana engine; the spell crystal's keywords do not matter.

Insert a spell core into the center. Primordial cores provide a base 512 su and 512 FE/s; Dream cores provide 1024 su and 1024 FE/s. Each core defines its own mechanical and electrical base output, multiplied by the three surrounding grids. Speed remains 16 rpm.

Kinetic output is fixed at 16 rpm and requires redstone by default. Use the controls to toggle operation, redstone control and rotation direction. A wrench changes its horizontal facing. Hold W over the item to ponder its operation.

Basic, Elemental, Arcane and Omni grids provide multipliers of 1.2, 1.5, 2 and 4. The three slots multiply together; output is rounded to the nearest integer only after all multipliers. Empty slots do not reduce output, and inserted spells are unnecessary.

With Create installed, the engine supplies stress. When FE integration is available, the same port also exports electricity according to the installed core and grid multipliers. Direct assembly-table drive does not require FE integration.
